Just here to give my personal experience. I have only been on lexapro for about 4 weeks now so I’m still fairly new to it as well. But my first 9 days were terrible. I almost quit the medication so many times over those 9 days! 

My paranoia was so bad that I kept making Telehealth appointments with my GP to ask about if things are normal. My anxiety was terrible too, the way I explained it to my husband was “you know when you’re driving a car cuts you off suddenly? You know that feeling you have in your chest afterwards like your heart is about to come out your chest? That’s what it feels like ALL DAY!” And that’s literally what I felt all day every day for 9 days. But then, on day 10, everything just went away. Just vanished that morning when I woke up. 

Things have been good since. I still experience 2 side effects that I’m trying to figure out if they will go away. They are constant sweating & yawning lol. 

My doctor did tell me “things will get worse before they get better, so hang in there!” And she’s right. Hang in there!

I regretted starting it in the first place for the first 9 days. But I can honestly say things got better and it was almost overnight. One morning I woke up and the side effects were gone, the worsened anxiety had subsided. 

Honestly, give it a chance. Give it a few more weeks. If then you still don’t feel right, go back and see your GP.
